text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up  we're getting a few requests asking whether managers can delegate final sign-off to an EM/IC when they're traveling during the final handback window. We should confirm policy + an auditable flow.
Rohan (Eng Manager): I had to leave mid-cycle last quarter and asked my EM to finalize some handbacks. We did that ad-hoc in Slack but got pinged during calibration. What's the official way to delegate without breaking audit/compliance?
Priya (HR Compliance): Short answer: delegation is allowed but must be explicitly recorded (who, why, and approval). We need an auditable record attached to the review before any rating changes.
Maya (People Ops): Proposed operational flow: 1) Manager creates a short delegation ticket via the extension form with fields: manager_email, delegate_email, reason_short, delegation_ts. 2) People Ops runs a scoped "apply-delegation" job that adds a delegation record to affected forms and issues audit IDs (DELEG-####). 3) Delegate can then complete handbacks; audit shows both original manager and delegate actions.
Rohan (Eng Manager): Sounds good. Can we do a CSV for bulk delegation (e.g., manager traveling with 20 reports)?
Maya (People Ops): Yes  CSV template below. We will only accept delegation CSVs from the manager's corporate email and a manager must be reachable (contact_phone optional).
```
manager_email,delegate_email,reviewee_email,form_id,reason_short,delegation_ts,contact_phone
rohan@redwood.ai,sam.em@redwood.ai,devon@redwood.ai,form_66021,travel to APAC,2026-06-10T07:15:00Z,+1-415-555-0101
```
Priya (HR Compliance): Compliance notes: delegation must be narrowly scoped (only handbacks/rating sign-off). Delegates cannot change calibration appeals or promotion recommendations without explicit manager confirmation recorded in the ticket. We will randomly audit ~5% of DELEG IDs.
Drew (IC): Will my review history show both manager and delegate? I want to confirm my timestamps and who submitted ratings.
Maya (People Ops): Yes. Self-review timestamps are immutable. The audit record will show delegate actions and original manager delegation record. Analytics will mark items "delegated" so chairs can see them in the appendix.
ops-bot: System notice: deadline enforcement will run at 2026-06-12T23:59:00Z. Manual delegation jobs require People Ops approval.
Rohan (Eng Manager): Operational question: if delegate submits while manager later revokes delegation, how do we handle conflicts?
Priya (HR Compliance): Revocation must be explicit and timestamped. If revocation arrives after delegate submission, the delegate's submission stands but flagged as "submitted-under-delegation"; manager can later submit a revision but it will create a new audit entry and require People Ops review if it changes promotion-impact fields.
Maya (People Ops): SLA: delegation CSVs processed within 6 business hours. Job will return audit IDs and a short CSV mapping input rows to DELEG-#### ids. Managers should not ask delegates to submit attachments until they get confirmation IDs.
Rohan (Eng Manager): Sending a small CSV for 3 reports now. Thanks all.
Maya (People Ops): Job complete  3 rows applied. Audit IDs: DELEG-9012, DELEG-9013, DELEG-9014. Appendix "delegations_june_2026.csv" added to calibration packet.
Drew (IC): Delegate submitted. Everything looks fine and I can see the DELEG tag in the form.
Priya (HR Compliance): We'll pick a sample of DELEG- IDs for compliance review. Please keep any supporting notes in the case ticket.
Maya (People Ops): I'll add a short how-to to the review ops page and a template link. Also filing a small UX request to show a "delegated" badge in the reviewer UI next cycle.
Rohan (Eng Manager): Great  closing loop. Thanks for the quick turn around. :thumbsup:
